description: x402-poly-history: Price time series for a Polymarket outcome token — first/last price, change in cents and percent, high, low, average, direction and volatility. Other Polymarket services show the current book; this one shows where the odds have been, which a momentum or mean-reversion decision needs. Optional: interval (1m,1h,6h,1d,1w,max; default 1d), fidelity in minutes (per-interval floor enforced), limit (default 500).
name: x402-poly-history
